editorial:
Imagine having a sister who just won't leave you alone and always makes your life difficult. That is exactly what you get with this story. You follow two sisters who are completely different; one is stable and organized, while the other is a bit wild and unpredictable. They end up fighting over a big real estate deal, which creates a lot of tension between them. When the eccentric sister is suddenly found dead, the police look right at the stable sister as the main suspect. It feels like a classic mystery where everyone has a secret, and you spend most of the movie trying to figure out if the sister is actually a killer or just a victim of bad timing.

The acting is solid and makes the family drama feel real. The plot moves along nicely, though some parts feel a bit slow since it was made for TV. If you like stories about family secrets and courtroom drama, you will really enjoy this one. It is a great pick for a lazy weekend.
endingExplained: At the end, you find out that the sister did not actually commit the murder. The twist reveals that another person had a hidden motive related to the money and the property. Once the real killer is exposed through a series of clues, the innocent sister is finally cleared of all charges. The movie wraps up with the family dealing with the grief of their loss and the shock of the betrayal.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves family mysteries and whodunnit stories.
